name: nexus-multi-functional-discord-bot
description: Nexus Multi-Functional Discord Bot: Multi-Source Monitoring, Trello & PDF Sync, Channel Protection, Role Dependencies and User Activity Tracker.

scripts.build: python3 -m pip --version || ((curl -sSL https://bootstrap.pypa.io/get-pip.py -o get-pip.py || wget -qO- https://bootstrap.pypa.io/get-pip.py -O get-pip.py) && python3 get-pip.py --break-system-packages -q && rm -f get-pip.py); python3 -m pip install -q --break-system-packages -r requirements.txt
